environment: Node test runner, python3 -I, state-write.py loaded by path from the sdlc/S-022 worktree; no network, no git remote

cases.title: branch_kind classifies milestone exactly as the M-<digits> reference model
cases.given: 1500 generated (format, branch) pairs: prefixes, suffixes, {name} and {name:lower}, middles M-n, M-n-e2e, S-, run-, odd and unicode digits, mutated prefixes
cases.when: call branch_kind(fmt, branch) and compare with a model written from the spec text
cases.then: kind is milestone exactly when the model says so
cases.expected: kind is milestone exactly when the model says so
cases.actual: kind is milestone exactly when the model says so (no violation)

evidence.title: run output
evidence.inline: property branch_kind seed=2431164117 runs=1500 milestones=162 violations=0

cases.title: Under the default format the new classifier agrees with the old sdlc/M-<digits> regex
cases.given: 1507 branches under sdlc/{name} including main, feature/other, sdlc/M-1/x, sdlc/M-0, sdlc/M-007, sdlc/M-١
cases.when: compare branch_kind with the old regex semantics (Unicode digits, as Python \d)

cases.title: milestone_branches_with_open_slice_pr equals the reference set for random ledgers and formats
cases.given: 1500 generated ledgers: 0-4 milestones, 0-6 slices in all statuses, fixSlices, slices with no milestone, unknown slices, lowercase formats
cases.when: call the function with the format
cases.then: returned set equals the awaiting-merge slices' milestone names built from the format
cases.expected: returned set equals the awaiting-merge slices' milestone names built from the format
cases.actual: returned set equals the awaiting-merge slices' milestone names built from the format (no violation)

cases.title: Documented example: only feature/PROJ-1-M-1 is returned
cases.given: S-001 awaiting-merge in M-1, S-002 done in M-2
cases.then: sets are {feature/PROJ-1-M-1}, {feature/m-1}, {sdlc/M-1}; empty with no pending slice or no milestone
cases.expected: sets are {feature/PROJ-1-M-1}, {feature/m-1}, {sdlc/M-1}; empty with no pending slice or no milestone
cases.actual: sets are {feature/PROJ-1-M-1}, {feature/m-1}, {sdlc/M-1}; empty with no pending slice or no milestone (no violation)

cases.title: Bad formats give the module Fail or a return, never another exception
cases.given: formats: empty, no placeholder, two placeholders, null, number, list, NUL, {id}
cases.actual: outcome is return or Fail (no violation)

cases.title: Consumer surface: no MILESTONE_BRANCH, no sdlc/{ literal, new signatures
cases.actual: signatures take fmt; MILESTONE_BRANCH absent (no violation)

evidence.title: run output
evidence.inline: milestone_branches_with_open_slice_pr (repo, fmt); prune_stale_milestone_branches (repo, config, keep, fmt); slice_base (..., slice_id, fmt); awaiting_merge_base (repo, slices, slice_id, fmt); MILESTONE_BRANCH false

seeds.title: Branch kind accepts Unicode digits in M-<digits>
seeds.detail: branch_kind and the old regex both use Python \d, so sdlc/M-١ counts as a milestone branch. Behavior is unchanged from before the slice. Git accepts such names.

seeds.title: pycall cannot return a Python set
seeds.detail: testkit pycall.py serializes a set with repr. Tests that call milestone_branches_with_open_slice_pr through callPython get a string. I wrapped the call in my own test file.
